title: Decision: Message.id is a stored receiver-assigned ULID
description: Audit item 1. Base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L588/L597 (jmap-chat-spec 5630c10): Message ids are ULIDs assigned by the receiving mailbox at storage time. Plan's id = seq is nonconformant. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): mint a monotonic ULID per follower_event at insert, stored in a new column added by migration 0006 (.11.3), not 0004 (.7.31 stays as implemented). seq remains the internal cursor.
